title: Purple Velvet Crop & Burnout Skirt
prompt: An original young woman with long, wavy honey-blonde hair walks a dirt path through tall grass. She wears a purple velvet cropped long-sleeve top with flared cuffs, a black velvet burnout maxi skirt with a side slit, and a chain belt with a cross charm. A black choker, layered silver necklaces, and small hoop earrings complete the look. Tall black boots show at the hem. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, late-afternoon light and blurred trees. Palette of violet, black, and sage green. Nostalgic and moody, in the style of a boho gothic editorial.
workingNotes:
- The velvet crop and chain belt with cross charm are the key details.
- Keep the path and grass for an organic, walking motion.
